The dining table occupies the center of the room, with the two chairs at opposite short ends so they face both the table and each other. This leaves generous circulation on all four sides. The sideboard, fridge, bar cart, entry bench, and floor lamp are distributed along the perimeter; the bench is directly against the west wall. Tableware and the vase arrangement are grouped on the dining table, while books, storage, and smaller decor are arranged on the sideboard and bar cart. Wall art, mirror, clock, and sconces are positioned above perimeter furniture without obstructing circulation.
[/Reason]
